candidates.angle: asuras cannot tell action from inaction
candidates.evidence: प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुः असुराः

candidates.angle: they have no purity or good conduct
candidates.evidence: न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते

candidates.angle: asuras see the world as born only of lust
candidates.evidence: born only from the union of male and female

angle_en: Asuras: unable to tell action from inaction
angle_hi: आसुरी लोग: कर्म और निवृत्तिको नहीं पहचान पाते

en.intro: Krishna has just described the divine nature. Now he asks what happens when a person cannot tell right action from wrong withdrawal.
en.notice: The asuras do not know what to pursue and what to withdraw from, and because they cannot make this basic choice, they end up without purity, conduct, or truth.
en.next: They say the world is unreal and born only of lust, and they deny any moral order.
en.meaning: People of a shadowed nature do not know what should be pursued and what should be withdrawn from. In them, there is no purity, no noble conduct, and no truthfulness.

hi.intro: कृष्ण ने अभी दिव्य प्रकृति बताई, अब वे बताते हैं कि जब मनुष्य सही और गलत कर्म में भेद नहीं कर पाता तो क्या होता है।
hi.meaning: आसुरी प्रकृति के लोग यह नहीं जानते कि क्या अपनाना चाहिए और क्या त्यागना चाहिए, और उनमें न तो पवित्रता, न श्रेष्ठ आचरण और न ही सत्य होता है।
hi.notice: आसुरी लोग प्रवृत्ति और निवृत्ति में भेद नहीं जानते, और इसी कारण वे शुद्धता, श्रेष्ठ आचरण और सत्य से पूरी तरह वंचित रह जाते हैं।
hi.next: वे कहते हैं कि यह संसार केवल पुरुष और स्त्री के संयोग से बना है और इसमें कोई व्यवस्था नहीं है।

The asuras do not know what to pursue and what to withdraw from, and because they cannot make this basic choice, they end up without purity, conduct, or truth. They say the world is unreal and born only of lust, and they deny any moral order.
